turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's zero.
What would you want me to say to Owen tomorrow?
That the zero is withdrawn, and that he shouldn't have found out from his phone in the middle of class. Say it to him privately. Not in front of anyone.
Like the actual words. Write it out for me and I'll read it to him.
Those are your words to write, Hale. I want the zero withdrawn first, in writing, then you can tell Owen whatever you like.
